Keep upper72% of both tall photos, and both complete center photos, visually IDENTICAL to input1. No need to make the caption panels small; full masked lower28% is required to avoid media fabrication.
Within left white panel, exact "テニスコート". Within right white panel, exact "眺めのよい公園". Meiryo REGULAR40014/24,tracking0, ink#1D1D1D, natural wrap, never bold. Purewhite#FFFFFF surfaces and gaps; fine neutral panel edge only. Original photo colors retained; no green/mint tint, no recoloring, no new icons/counts/arrows or actions. Output same approximately1.23:1 source gallery aspect, smallwhiteoutermargin. Only two white caption overlays change. Original media and fine details override all secondary references. No photo beautification or enlargement reconstruction.
